purpose: Third training seed (32345) of holdout_sel1m_v1: standard ParT (Weaver flat+decay restarted from the epoch-17 checkpoint, start LRs 1e-5 to 1e-3), the constant-LR grid (6e-5 to 1.6e-4) and the fast windowed PBT with fallback copies, each selected on sel1m_tail (global best). Fixed before training. Primary comparison: fast PBT against standard ParT. Secondary: fast PBT against the constant-LR grid, and the constant-LR grid against standard ParT.
